capabilities: search emoji by broad keywords, colors, and feelings
insert emoji at the cursor from a keyboard-navigable grid popup
bind a hotkey to open the emoji search panel
extras: States it is local-only with no internet access; notes that unsupported emoji render as empty rectangles on older devices and that startup time is slowed by parsing the large thesaurus file. Install steps mistakenly say to search for "Magic File Hotkey". Includes a disclaimer that it is not an officially supported Google product.
intentEvidence: Note: This is an Obsidian-compatible fork of the Emoji Magic Chrome Extension I wrote.
motivation: The author lists existing emoji plugins and explains why they fell short: shortcode syntax was unwanted, and Emoji Toolbar used images that looked different from inserted emoji and had insertion bugs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in emoji picker, and typing emoji by shortcode or hunting through lists makes finding the right one while writing slow.

summary: Emoji picker that inserts real Unicode emoji at the cursor via hotkey, using a large keyword and thesaurus search dictionary.
